sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that a sale-deed was executed.
Subsequently, on the basis of a report submitted by the Lekhpal, it transpired that the land comprising Khasra No. 529 was occupied by various persons and was a Abadi Bhumi.
Subsequently, on the basis of the same satellite image, a view was formed that the property in question belongs to the Defence Department and was wrongly soled.

Sale-deed was executed by one Majid in favour of Public Limited Company namely M/s Sem Tech. Associates Pvt. Ltd.
3.

It is argued by counsel for the applicant that neither the purchaser nor anybody on his behalf has made any allegation with regard to the sale-deed in question and solely based upon some survey Ajay Veer Singh vs State Of U.P. on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148328138/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is argued that one of the co-accused Samir Malik was enlarged on anticipatory bail vide order dated 6.11.2023.

It is also argued that in fact, the District Magistrate has issued a show cause notice under the provisions of the Stamp Act for recovery of alleged deficiency of Stamp Duty to the purchaser of the property in question under Section 47A of the Stamp Act.
It is also argued that the applicant was granted a short term anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 19.9.2023.
The applicant has not misused the said liberty and the applicant has no criminal antecedents.
He is in custody since 16.11.2023.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer, by arguing that a large scale of fraud is being committed by the persons who are selling the property not owned by them.
5. Considering the submissions made at the bar, what transpires is that with regard to the nature of the property pertaining to which the sale-deed has been executed.
No proceedings have been concluded so far to determine the actual ownership.
It can be done only after demarcation proceedings are initiated.
No proceedings for cancellation of the sale-deed have been initiated so far.
The purchaser of the property has not made any allegation with regard to the sale-deed executed in their favour.

The charge-sheet has already been filed and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicantAjay Veer Singhbe released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 419 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC, P.S. Sihani Gate, District Ghaziabad, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs. 1,00,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.12.2023 S.A.
